name: Home health and personal care aides
oneLiner: The largest source of new jobs in the US economy — and the one AI helps least.
why: Hands-on physical assistance: lifting, transferring, bathing, gait belts
The work is a relationship, and the client can tell the difference
Licensing, liability and dignity keep a human accountable for the outcome
Demand is driven by demographics, not by software adoption
threats: Median pay is $35,800 — a job-quality crisis, not an AI story
Most openings replace workers who leave, not new growth
Charting, scheduling and vitals logging will leave the human's plate

claims.text: Adds more jobs than any other occupation published by the US Bureau of Labor Statistics.
About 760,500 openings a year, most of them replacing workers who leave rather than new positions.
AI's documented value in care is documentation, scheduling and monitoring; experts across the care workforce reject it as a substitute for physical assistance or human relationships.
